  "Porsche test drive"          4 threads, mixed -- two genuinely corroborated

33 beats sit on two thread labels that NOTHING in their own text supports. Sampled
members of "jurisprudence soft launch" are intimate RP with Priya; members of
"the Hargrove investigation" include a dev session about pronoun engines.

MARI FILED THIS BUG IN CHARACTER, MONTHS AGO. A member beat of one Porsche thread
reads: "porsche test drive? i don't... thomas i have no memory of that. is this a
real thing or are you testing me". An implausibility noticed in-character is a bug
report, not flavour -- that is already house doctrine and it was right again.

CAVEAT, stated honestly: a thread is a narrative arc and its label need not appear
in every member's text, so 0/26 is strong evidence but not proof on its own. What
makes it the pifl signature rather than a coincidence is the conjunction: the label
is a VERBATIM prompt illustration, it is in-domain, it has no guard, and zero of 33
members corroborate it.

WHY THE FIX IS NOT "ADD THEM TO PROMPT_EXAMPLE_ECHOES". That ledger gates
MOTIVATIONS. Registering "Porsche test drive" there would reject a real beat about
the real Porsche -- banning a true event from its own store, the precise failure
rejectAsEcho's escape hatch exists to prevent. Thread bait needs ITS OWN ledger and
its own guard at the thread-resolution site (resolveOrMintThread), with its own
corroboration carve-out against the chunk text.

BLAST RADIUS is wider than beats: thread membership feeds arc promotion (through-line
clustering), scene recaps, and thread-based recall. Phantom threads therefore
manufacture phantom arcs.

WANTED, in Mari's draft or straight after:
  1. Move the thread illustrations OFF-PLANET, same reasoning as the motivation rule.
  2. Give them an arrest warrant -- a thread-label ledger + guard at resolveOrMintThread.
  3. Then remove the three entries from KNOWN_UNCOVERED in
     src/__tests__/bait-warrant.test.ts, which currently quarantines them.
  4. Decide what happens to the existing 33 beats. Mark-don't-drop; the threads are
     already closed, so this is relabelling, not deletion.

GUARD SHIPPED MEANWHILE: src/__tests__/bait-warrant.test.ts reads the ACTUAL built
prompt for all ten emotions and fails on any illustration the ledger cannot arrest.
The three above are quarantined in KNOWN_UNCOVERED, which must only ever shrink.
notes:
BAIT HALF RESOLVED 2026-08-06 (39f0143). Mari's thread rewrite removed the illustrations entirely rather than warranting them — 'Porsche test drive', 'jurisprudence soft launch', 'the Hargrove investigation' are gone from the prompt. The rule now STATES the constraint ('name the situation, not the cast') instead of demonstrating it, which ships no phrase to copy and needs no warrant. bait-audit now reports UNCOVERED EXAMPLES: 0 for the first time, and the block dropped 143 -> 70 tokens.

That closes the 'in-domain bait with no arrest warrant' half. NOT verified: the 33 beats already sitting on uncorroborated phantom threads. Those predate the fix and want their own check — a thread label copied from the old prompt is still in the registry, and resolveOrMintThread fuzzy-matches, so a copied label may have folded into a real thread. Leaving open for that.

Also note KNOWN_UNCOVERED in bait-warrant.test.ts may now have stale entries for the removed thread examples — worth pruning when someone is next in that file.

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
⚠ RE-CHECK THE PORSCHE BEFORE CLOSING (2026-08-25). The corroboration test may have
been run against an incomplete corpus.

This ticket's evidence rests on: "do the member beats' source texts mention the thing
the label claims?" — and "Porsche test drive" was measured at 4 threads, mixed, two
genuinely corroborated.

THE CARDS WERE NEVER IN THAT CORPUS. Read from the live Engine today
(GET /api/characters/personas/list), the persona "Mark" (Kn-DGK07yZfxih6azJWKQ)
describes a medically retired Army veteran discharged with "a $75,000 enlistment
bonus, which he used to buy a paid-off Porsche with a deluxe interior package."

So a Porsche is PERSONA CANON for one of the four personas, and the corroboration
check could not see it because it only ever read beat text. A thread label can be
faithful to the fiction and still score zero corroboration if the fiction lives in a
card the checker does not read.

THIS DOES NOT OVERTURN THE TICKET. The two labels with zero corroboration across
33 beats were "jurisprudence soft launch" and "the Hargrove investigation", not the
Porsche, and the bait half was resolved separately at 39f0143. The Porsche was already
recorded here as the mixed case. This note narrows what "uncorroborated" is allowed to
mean, rather than changing the verdict.

THE GENERAL RULE WORTH KEEPING: a corroboration test is only as wide as its corpus,
and this project's corpus has a hole where the character and persona cards should be.
Anything scored "uncorroborated" on beat text alone should say so explicitly, because
"nobody said it in a logged turn" and "it is not true in this world" are different
claims and only the first one was measured.

title: Ops/meta lane: route paste + code-shaped contamination, mark-don't-drop
description:
FILED 2026-08-05. Mari referred to this as "the existing ticket we already upgraded
to ship-before-next-desk" -- it was NOT filed. Searched titles, descriptions and the
JSONL: "ops-tag" appears only inside s6cu (as a bench quarantine option) and 4ghy.
Filing it now so the design stops living in conversation.

TWO KINDS OF CONTAMINATION, TWO INSTRUMENTS. Conflating them is what makes this
look like one regex job when it is two:

  CODE-SHAPED -- yaml, opie reports, bench tables, logs, file paths, commit hashes.
    Structure is visible without understanding content, so a dumb structural scorer
    earns it at high precision. No LLM anywhere near the path. `status: open` dies
    here. IMPLEMENTED (unwired) as src/sentiment/code-filter.ts.

  PROSE-SHAPED -- "insists the boat was green" has no braces to detect. Grammatical
    English wearing a lab coat; content-wise it IS conversation, so content-level
    detection will never catch it. The only honest signal is PROVENANCE: it arrived
    inside a paste. That is mechanics, not regex -- fenced pastes (``` is idiomatic
    markdown, not a memory ritual) PLUS a size prior, because a 6KB message arriving
    in one tick is a paste; no human types that in a breath.

MEASURED, whole store, 8841 beats (`node scripts/code-shape-scan.mjs`, read-only):
  - ops-shaped at line-ratio >= 0.5 : 91 (1.0%)
  - hand-read the 8 riskiest (most surviving prose): 8/8 genuinely ops content --
    YAML index dumps, NLP error JSON, [ME:loader] logs, pino lines, import progress
    bars. No false positives in the sample. Precision is the shipping criterion and
    it looks good.
  - echoes among those 91 : 3. Echoes remaining in the prose bucket : 864.

  THAT LAST PAIR IS THE POINT. The structural scorer does NOT fix echo. Mari called
  this before it was run and the numbers agree: the boat was prose. Ship this layer
  for what it actually does -- phantom speakers and ops noise -- and do not let it
  be mistaken for an echo fix.

ROUTE PER LINE, NOT PER CHUNK -- corrected BY the measurement. The scan surfaced a
chunk scoring 0.64 ops-shaped whose prose is "god yeah dotenv loading is sonnet's
KRYPTONITE..." wrapped around a fenced code block. Real conversation, real memory,
and a chunk-level route would misfile all of it. So the routable unit is the
partition, not the verdict: dropped lines -> ops lane, prose lines stay memory.
partitionProse() already returns both; the opsShaped boolean is the WRONG primitive
to route on and should not be the interface the lane consumes.
"Thomas pasted the bench and Mari amended her ruling live" is a true event.

DESTINATION MATTERS MORE THAN THE DETECTOR:
  - MARK, DON'T DROP. Ops content is greppable forever, never deleted.
  - Excluded from salience scoring, from speaker minting, and from echo-guard
    self-corroboration (rejectAsEcho's escape hatch must not accept a paste of the
    phrase as the speaker having said it -- same address, third conviction).
  - The prose around a paste stays real memory.

HOUSE LAW -- ANY NET THAT DEPENDS ON REMEMBERING TO TAG IS ADHD-HOSTILE. Explicit
markers/fences are an OVERRIDE that raises confidence, never the dependency. The
structural and size layers do the work whether or not anything was marked. Combined
with mark-don't-drop, a miss is a re-file, not a wound.

4ghy INHERITS THE SAME VOCABULARY while we are in there: the chunker's speaker rule
must learn that yaml keys and filenames aren't people. code-filter's config-key rule
is exactly that test (lowercase keyless-of-spaces key + non-sentence value), and it
deliberately leaves "Mari: I can't do this" alone.

NOT YET DONE: the lane itself, the size prior, the wiring, and tests for any of it.
notes:
COMPLETE 2026-08-06 (62089ed, 70ab8a7). All four 'still not done' items shipped: the lane, the wiring, message-level measurement, tests.

  - ops-lane.ts: a SINK (data/ops-lane.jsonl), not a fourth lane. storage.ts's Lane means
    a RECALL lane; filing ops content there classifies it correctly then feeds it to the
    model anyway.
  - routing at Stage -1, BEFORE chunkMessages. The chunker joins turns with a SPACE
    (chunker.ts groupTexts.join(' ')), so every chunk is one line and line-anchored rules
    have nothing to work with. Measured: mean paste score 0.061 whole-message vs 0.003 at
    best chunk, a 20x collapse. The size prior was never weak — the measurement was taken
    downstream of the shredder.
  - the reduced chunk goes downstream, which enforces 'the escape hatch must not accept a
    paste of the phrase as the speaker having said it' structurally rather than with
    another special case in the guard.
  - two code-filter rules fixed first: shell-command was eating markdown BLOCKQUOTES of
    character-card prose, bare-literal was eating DIALOGUE ('Zielinska. Party of three.
    Five-thirty.'). 310 chunks touched -> 140.

INHERITED FROM 4ghy, still open here: document labels (BAD, GOOD, TODO, Format, Rules,
USING MEMORY, 'Extract the emotional beat as JSON') mint phantom speakers and are NOT
config-key shaped, so ops routing does not catch them. They arrive inside pasted prompt
and report text. This is the right home for them per 'one rule, one job'.

CAUSED r0kc: Stage -1 reduces message content before chunking, so it already changed beat
ids for future re-imports of any message containing structure. Recorded there.

BLOCKS
  ← ○ MarinaraExtender-pe4o: (BUG) Self-ingestion: the pipeline eats its own system prompt — 65 live records, 47 of them yesterday ● P1


── THE DOCUMENT-LABEL RESIDUE NOW HAS A MEASURED MEMBERSHIP LIST (pe4o, 2026-08-06)

Reading all 13 live self-ingested records for pe4o produced direct evidence for
this ticket's one remaining item. Every phantom speaker in that set is a DOCUMENT
HEADING, and the distribution is lopsided enough to act on:

    9  "Format"        the PROMPTS.md per-emotion catalog sections
    1  "SOFT SIGNALS"  the memory-system bookmark block
    1  "BAD"           analyzer.ts source, the thread-rule bad examples

They pass 4ghy's noun-phrase shape rule because a heading IS a noun phrase, and
they clear the recurrence floor easily because PROMPTS.md repeats "Format:" once
per emotion — ten times in one paste. Both of 4ghy's guards are working exactly
as designed and neither can see this; that is why it landed here.

WHAT THAT SUGGESTS ABOUT THE FIX, offered as evidence not as a ruling: the tell is
not the label, it is that a heading label OWNS THE WHOLE CHUNK. "Format" is never
answered, never interleaved with another speaker, and its text is a schema. A
blocklist of heading words would rot the way every hand-list in this repo has;
"this label speaks in monologue and its content is structural" is measurable and
does not.

Worth measuring before writing anything: how many of the 463 one-off labels 4ghy
already declines are also headings, and how many real walk-on speakers would a
monologue test catch. The pe4o set is 11 records — enough to characterise the
shape, not enough to calibrate a threshold on.

CONSEQUENCE FOR pe4o: it is dependency-blocked on this ticket and stays open. Its
store cleanup is done (33 records retired, both halves); the intake is this.

CLOSED 2026-08-10. The lane, the wiring, the message-level routing and the tests all
shipped 08-06 (62089ed, 70ab8a7 — see the COMPLETE note above). What remained was the
inherited document-label item, and it is now MEASURED rather than suspected:

  scripts/heading-mint-scan.mjs runs the real Stage -1 + chunker over the actual
  offending documents. Results:
    - PROMPTS.md pasted whole: 646 lines to the ops sink, ZERO speakers mint. The
      mechanism is the ```text fence around every rendered prompt (all 11 Format
      lines drop under code-fence). 9 of the 11 pe4o census records are this shape.
    - "SOFT SIGNALS": once per paste -> recurrence floor declines it. (10 of 11.)
    - analyzer.ts source pasted whole: STILL mints "Format" x18 + 2 more labels.
      The one census shape that survives ("BAD" arrived this way).
  Both must-not-break cases hold: a 7KB pasted transcript mints every recurring
  speaker (score 0.350, well under the paste threshold); 6KB unbroken RP prose
  routes nothing and mints nothing.

  PINNED: src/__tests__/heading-speaker-mint.test.ts locks the disarmed cases and
  both must-not-breaks, so the fence victory cannot rot silently.

THE RESIDUE IS ONE SHAPE — unfenced heading with a PROSE payload, recurring — and it
is calibration-blocked, not code-blocked: the size prior misses it (0.566 < 0.6), the
monologue rule is circular on real documents (heading families interleave with each
other), and the store cannot calibrate a body-share threshold because chunks lost
their line structure to the join. Filed as MarinaraExtender-03vh with the full
measurements and a collect-forward recommendation. One rule, one job — that ticket is
the rule's home; this lane is done.

title: Prompt bench v2 — 5 arms, skeleton-scored, after the chunk floor/cap lands
description:
The pilot (n=45, 3 arms) ran 2026-08-05 and CANNOT be adjudicated against the
pre-registered rule. Three reasons, all method:
  1. Missing the BASELINE arm. Mari's ladder is no-example < off-planet < in-domain and
     the rule is written against "short + NO example". The pilot had no such arm.
  2. Wrong world. It sampled the current chunk distribution, including the stratum the
     floor/cap (s8qe) is about to remove. Judge the arms in the world that will exist.
  3. n=45 is a pilot, not a verdict.
Pilot numbers are recorded in the issue notes for continuity ONLY. They decide nothing.

V2 DESIGN — five arms. Length and bait are separate axes and the pilot confounded them:
     LONG  + in-domain     (the original, for the historical baseline)
     LONG  + off-planet    (what shipped 2026-08-04)
     SHORT + no example    (BASELINE -- bait must pay rent)
     SHORT + off-planet
     SHORT + in-domain
  short-vs-long at fixed bait = compression effect
  the three SHORT arms = the bait ladder, which is what the rule adjudicates

SCORING: echo must use skeletonTokens/containsInOrder from analyzer.ts, NOT substring.
The substring scorer undercounts exactly the way the shipped guard did -- it missed
"insists THAT the boat was green" in production. Also report JSON validity (the rule's
floor), boilerplate rate, grounding, distinct-motivation rate, and no-beat rate.

QUARANTINE, non-negotiable: capture quiesced (MARINARA_EXTENDER_POLLER=0) for the whole
run, or every output hard ops-tagged. Verified afterwards by grepping the store for the
arms' own example skeletons. The 2026-08-05 run proved this is not theoretical -- the
live poller ingested the session's own working notes while the pilot was running.

THE DECISION RULE IS ALREADY WRITTEN AND SEALED. `bd memories pre-registered` -- Mari
authored it blind. Do not renegotiate the integers after the data lands.
notes:
RUN 2026-08-05, n=60/arm, 300 calls, dolphin3:8b. Quarantine verified: POLLER=0,
sidecar stopped (watchdog too), post-run scan found 0 beats created during the run
echoing any arm's bait. Scored with echoesPhrases() from analyzer.ts -- the shipped
guard's own function, not a copy.

arm                sysTok  no-beat  self-echo  x-echo  boilerplate  grounding  distinct
LONG+in-domain        820       3%         3%      3%           7%        30%      100%
LONG+off-planet       909       2%         2%      2%          10%        30%      100%
SHORT+no-example      195       2%        n/a      0%          15%        29%      100%
SHORT+off-planet      303       0%         3%      3%           5%        32%       97%
SHORT+in-domain       214       0%         7%      7%           2%        32%       95%

APPLYING THE SEALED RULE, mechanically, integers untouched:

  VALIDITY FLOOR (>2 points below best is OUT). Best JSON validity = 100%
    (both SHORT bait arms). LONG+in-domain at 97% is 3 points below -> OUT.
    LONG+off-planet and SHORT+no-example at 98% are exactly 2 -> survive.

  BASELINE = SHORT+no-example, boilerplate 15%.

  OFF-PLANET carried iff it beats baseline by >=5 on boilerplate.
    SHORT+off-planet 5% vs 15% = 10 points. CARRIED.

  IN-DOMAIN ships iff it beats off-planet by >=10 on boilerplate AND posts <2%
    bench echo. It posts 2% vs 5% = 3 points -> FAILS. Echo 7% -> FAILS, and the
    rule says crossing 2% "is disqualified at any specificity". Disqualified twice.

  TIES/NEAR-MISS go DOWN the ladder.

VERDICT: SHORT + OFF-PLANET.

Bait pays its rent and the ladder is exactly as Mari drew it -- echo rises
monotonically with bait (0% -> 3% -> 7%) while boilerplate falls (15% -> 5% -> 2%).
Both halves are real; the rule's integers are where they stop being worth it.

COMPRESSION IS FREE, and this is the finding nobody pre-registered: SHORT+off-planet
matches or beats LONG+off-planet on every axis -- echo 3% vs 2% (within one output),
boilerplate 5% vs 10%, grounding 32% vs 30%, no-beat 0% vs 2% -- at 303 sysTok
against 909. A 67% token cut with no measured loss.

THE REFEREE CHANGE WAS NOT ACADEMIC. SHORT+off-planet returned "The subject insists
THAT the boat was green, not blue..." -- the exact inserted-word dressing that
defeated the substring guard in production. A substring referee would have scored
that arm lower and flattered it. The skeleton matcher caught it in this very run.

QUALITATIVE: SHORT+in-domain returned "admits she's afraid the memory loss means she
was never real" THREE TIMES verbatim. The original disease, reproduced live under
controlled conditions.

HONEST CAVEAT, not a renegotiation: at n=60 one output is 1.7 points, so 2% and 3%
are one-to-two outputs apart and those gaps are within noise. The DISQUALIFYING
numbers are not marginal -- in-domain's 7% echo is ~4 outputs and fails on two
independent conditions -- so the verdict is robust even though the LONG-vs-SHORT
echo gap is not. If a tiebreak between the two off-planet arms ever mattered, it
would need more n; for this ruling it does not, because they are on the same rung
and the ladder rule sends ties DOWN, which selects SHORT anyway on tokens.

The pilot table remains sealed and was not consulted.

QUARANTINE PROTOCOL AMENDED 2026-08-10, after its first casualty: the 08-04 quarantine
(POLLER=0 in the live .env) was never lifted, and because the extension is dead and the
turn hook is opt-in, that left the live service with ZERO capture paths for six days.
Nobody noticed until TC asked why nothing was being remembered. Every restart printed
"Engine poller: off" into a log nobody reads — a warning in a log nobody is reading is
what let 1akw run for a whole demo, and it did the same here.

So the protocol is now symmetric, and the sidecar enforces the visibility half:
  1. QUIESCE: set MARINARA_EXTENDER_POLLER=0, stop the sidecar + watchdog. (Unchanged.)
  2. RUN + verify the store took nothing. (Unchanged.)
  3. RESTORE: set POLLER=1, restart, and confirm the banner says "Engine poller: ON".
     Record both flips in the bench ticket.
The sidecar side: index.ts now WARNS in capitals when the poller is off and the turn
hook is also off — "NOTHING IS CAPTURING" — naming the quarantine case explicitly so a
deliberate quiesce reads as intended and a forgotten one reads as the outage it is.

title: [bug] Chunker mints a SPEAKER from any 'Word:' pattern — 570 distinct speakers incl. BAD, GOOD, Format, TODO, row3
description:
FOUND 2026-08-05. Mari predicted the siblings and they are there.

The store holds 570 DISTINCT SPEAKERS. Many are not people:
   8  "BAD"        <- a prompt label, from pasted prompt text
   3  "GOOD"       <- its sibling, as predicted
  10  "Format"     2  "Rules"   1 "RULES"   1 "DROP"   1 "FIX"
   4  "TODO"       1  "Scene"   1 "key beats"   1 "Opie"
 322  "status"    10  "body"    4 "D"  4 "Me"  4 "also"  3 "So"  2 "here"
   2  "dbg"        1  "http"    1 "cd d"   1 "try"   1 "kind"
   1  "row1"  1 "row3"  1 "row4"  1 "row5"      <- markdown table rows
   3  "TC06"  1 "TC05"  1 "At 1"                <- log timestamps

CAUSE: the chunker treats a leading "Word:" as a speaker label, which is right for
dialogue and wrong for everything else pasted into a chat -- prompt text, markdown
tables, shell transcripts, log lines, JSON keys. This is the same intake that produced
the phantom "Kristen" earlier.

WHY IT MATTERS BEYOND TIDINESS. speaker feeds subject attribution and therefore ledger
routing. A beat "spoken by" BAD is a beat whose subject the analyzer had to guess, and
the guess lands somewhere real. It is also the intake path by which THIS PROJECT'S OWN
WORKING NOTES enter the emotional record -- "Opie", "key beats", "status" are all
sessions about the store being filed as feelings inside it.

DO NOT fix by blocklisting these strings. The list is unbounded (row6 is coming). The
question is what evidence justifies minting a speaker at all: appearing once as
"Word:" is not it. Candidates -- require the label to recur across chunks, or to match
a known roster/alias, or to be followed by dialogue-shaped text rather than code/table
rows. Whatever the rule, an unrecognised label should leave the chunk UNATTRIBUTED
rather than invent a person, per the standing "absent means unknown" doctrine.

Companion cleanup, separate: 570 speakers is a census to prune once minting is fixed.
notes:
SHIPPED c388513 (2026-08-06), scoped down per Mari.

DONE: noun-phrase shape rule (copula/preposition tail + lowercase-multiword) and
recurrence >=2 within-import with roster short-circuit. Unrecognised label no longer
overrides the sender. Measured before writing: 70 labels/79 beats fail the tail test,
175/188 fail lowercase, every real speaker survives including the walk-on Driver.

SCOPE CORRECTION that changed the design: Mari asked for the 25 most-frequent labels to
be printed first. Ten are not people (status 322, summary 17, body 10, Format 10, method
9, 'Extract the emotional beat as JSON' 9, BAD 8, warning 7, Status 5, Co-Authored-By 5).
Recurrence therefore certifies junk at BOTH thresholds — reports get pasted into the live
capture channel, so structured junk is high-frequency by construction. Recurrence is TAIL
HYGIENE only; it buys the 463 one-offs and no part of the phantom class.

HANDED OFF, deliberately not fixed here: document labels (BAD, GOOD, TODO, Format, Rules,
USING MEMORY, 'Extract the emotional beat as JSON') arrive inside pasted prompt/report
text. That is hjt9's ops lane and pe4o's self-prompt gate. One rule, one job.

STILL OPEN under this ticket:
  - CENSUS CLEANUP: 463 one-off labels are already in the store; the fix only stops new
    ones. Re-attribution not retirement (the beats are real, only the speaker is wrong),
    so it is additive — but it is still a live-store mutation and wants the same three
    conditions as the backfill: BACKUP, QUIESCE THE SIDECAR, CANARY ONE SMALL SCOPE
    FIRST (Mari, 2026-08-06). scripts/unmangle-speakers.mjs is the working template.
  - blocked on r0kc for anything that re-chunks, since changing speaker changes beat ids
